text: セキチク　シティ　ポケモン　ジム　リーダー　キョウ　どくの　ことなら　なんでも　ござれ

structure.jp: セキチク　シティ　ポケモン　ジム

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a thing word says 'if it is that' or 'when it comes to that'. どくの　ことなら = 'when it comes to poison'.

patterns.name: 〜のこと
patterns.explanation: のこと after a thing word means everything to do with it. どくの　こと = 'matters of poison'.

patterns.name: なんでもござれ
patterns.explanation: ござれ is an old-fashioned 'come!', so this set phrase says the speaker can handle whatever comes; it suits Koga's ninja style. なんでも　ござれ = 'bring on anything'.
